# KOYN FX MCP

Public listing for the [KOYN FX](https://agent.koynfx.com/mcp) remote MCP server.

Connect MCP clients to `https://agent.koynfx.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP + OAuth).

This repository is the GitHub-backed listing for the [MCP Registry](https://github.com/mcp). Product source stays in the private agent app.
